title: Transport of actual enriched coefficient projections and their degree-zero action
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and a scheme $W$, with the same positive finite quotient sheaves $B_n$, completed coefficient sheaf A, ordinary derived system category, normalized objects, actual total limit L and finite derived scalar extensions $T_n$ as defined in [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-pc-scheme, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-coef-ringed-sequence-site, def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower, def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data]. Let S be a CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus, D a CoefficientDerivedSystemResolutionCoherence for S, and H : CoefficientDerivedSystemProjectionModels S D [def-coef-derived-system-projection-models]. Write $\mathcal R\dashv L$ for S's adjunction, $\rho_n:e_n\mathcal R\cong T_n$ for its reduction-evaluation comparison, $\pi_n:L N\to\operatorname{Res}_n e_nN$ for the actual total-limit projection, and $\gamma_{P,N}$ for S's specified enriched adjunct followed by derived sections and its global-limit comparison. For every integral derived P, normalized derived system N and n, the actual nth mapping-limit projection of $\gamma_{P,N}$, followed by S's finite global-Hom fiber identification, is $R\operatorname{Hom}_A(P,\pi_n)$ followed by derived scalar-adjunction, D's scalar-sections comparison and the first-variable transport by $\rho_n(P)$. This is precisely CoefficientGammaProjection S D of [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data], with all maps fixed there. Its degree-zero action under the recorded natural additive identifications of $H^0R\operatorname{Hom}$ with derived morphisms [def-coef-hom-zero-cycle-class] sends any $h:P\to L N$ to
$$\rho_n(P)\,;T_n(h)\,;\rho_n(LN)^{-1}\,;e_n(\epsilon_N):e_n\mathcal R P\longrightarrow e_nN.$$
Here $\epsilon_N$ is S's counit and semicolons denote composition in the displayed order. This is CoefficientHomProjection S for H-zero of coefficientGammaZeroMap itself. There is no assertion that a calculus exists, that beta is invertible, or that integral Hom commutes with finite scalar extension.

proof.text: Transport S and D to the actual sequence-site and strict-system presentations using their identity-on-sections equivalence. Tensor comparison representative normalizations give the scalar model assumptions of the enriched sequence projection theorem; unit_projection and reductionTensor_evaluation give its unit and tensor compatibility equations.

Apply the enriched sequence projection formula. Its two inverse Hom bijections uniquely identify the evaluated enriched projection with the finite scalar internal-Hom adjunct after Hom of pi_n. Universal right-derived comparison units identify its global-limit and finite sections comparisons with D.globalLimit_model, D.globalEvaluation_model and D.scalarSections_model. The transported equality is exactly CoefficientGammaProjection. Use H.sections_projection for the ordinary sections/limit projection after internal Hom; arbitrary finite sections comparisons without this normalization would not suffice.

Apply the final H-zero clause of the same theorem. The recorded cocycle-class normalizations and D ordinary/derived scalar section equations fix both endpoint transports. Rewrite the scalar adjunct of pi_n with counit_projection, and use naturality of rho_n on h. The result is rho_n(P);T_n(h);rho_n(LN) inverse;e_n(epsilon_N), the actual coefficientGammaZeroMap formula. H.scalar_hom_zero fixes the finite enriched comparison on H-zero. Naturality of the recorded H-zero Hom identifications handles Hom of pi_n and the first-variable reduction transport.
